stayText: Choose your perfect apartment and unwind after a day exploring the trails of the Tatra Mountains.

items.name: Strążyska Valley
items.description: A peaceful forest trail follows a mountain stream to the picturesque Strążyska Clearing, offering impressive views of Giewont. Perfect for a relaxing walk and your first introduction to the Tatra Mountains.

items.name: Siklawica Waterfall
items.description: A beautiful waterfall hidden at the foot of Giewont. The route passes through Strążyska Valley and its scenic clearing before continuing along a rocky path to the waterfall.

items.name: Sarnia Skała
items.description: One of the most beautiful viewpoints in the area, offering panoramic views of Zakopane and the impressive northern face of Giewont. The trail includes a steep climb and a rocky final section.

items.name: Dolina ku Dziurze & Dziura Cave
items.description: A short, peaceful forest trail through a quiet valley leads to a natural cave hidden among the rocks. A lovely choice for a little adventure without a long hike.

items.name: Białego Valley
items.description: A scenic valley with rocky cliffs, wooden bridges and a mountain stream forming small cascades. Enjoy a short walk to the waterfall or continue hiking towards Sarnia Skała.

items.name: Za Bramką Valley
items.description: A quiet valley surrounded by limestone cliffs, with a forest path following a gentle stream. Ideal for a short, relaxing walk away from the busier hiking routes.

items.name: Droga pod Reglami
items.via: From Strążyska Valley to Za Bramką Valley
items.description: A scenic walking route along the foothills of the Tatras, passing forests and open meadows. It connects several beautiful valleys, letting you choose your own distance and direction.

items.name: Mała Łąka Valley
items.description: A peaceful forest hike leading to a wide mountain clearing surrounded by impressive Tatra peaks. A wonderful choice for a longer walk with beautiful mountain panoramas.

timeNote: The walking times are approximate and refer to a one-way hike from the indicated trailhead, excluding the walk from the apartments and any breaks. Difficulty ratings assume good weather conditions. Check current conditions in Tatra National Park before setting off.
conditionsNote: Check current trail conditions before heading out.
